keyEvents.text: Facundo Bernal (Real Betis) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Rahim Ibrahim (Slovan Bratislava) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Slovan Bratislava 0, Real Betis 1. Cucho Hernández (Real Betis) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ángel Ortiz with a cross.
First Half ends, Slovan Bratislava 0, Real Betis 1.
Substitution, Real Betis. Marc Roca replaces Facundo Bernal.
Goal! Slovan Bratislava 0, Real Betis 2. Cucho Hernández (Real Betis) header from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Isco with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Real Betis. Álvaro Fidalgo replaces Isco.
Substitution, Real Betis. Troy Parrott replaces Cucho Hernández.
Substitution, Slovan Bratislava. Alasana Yirajang replaces Nino Marcelli.
Substitution, Slovan Bratislava. Cristian Martínez replaces Rahim Ibrahim.
Substitution, Real Betis. Aitor Ruibal replaces Antony.
Substitution, Slovan Bratislava. Adam Griger replaces Andraz Sporar.
Substitution, Slovan Bratislava. Alexej Maros replaces Tigran Barseghyan.
Substitution, Real Betis. Rodrigo Riquelme replaces Abde Ezzalzouli.
Second Half ends, Slovan Bratislava 0, Real Betis 2.
